construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
City of San Jose permit PRE23-191 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2023), status Complete: "SB330 Preliminary Application for a townhome development of 107 units"

City of San Jose permit H24-021 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2024), status Inactive: "Development Permit Application for the demolition two existing commercial buildings totalling approximately 47,431 square feet, the removal of 122 trees (97 ordinance-size and 25 non-ordinance-size) for the construction of 128 residential condominium unit" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City of San Jose permit T24-013 (Tentative Map, folder year 2024), status Under Review: "Vesting Tentative Map to subdivide one existing lot into 14 residential lots with up to 139 residential condominium units on an approximately 4.91-gross-acre site."

City permits layer shows the site development permit application filed 2024-05-03 (demolition of two commercial buildings totaling about 47,431 sq ft, removal of 122 trees, 128 condominium units) with status Inactive. The vesting tentative map, General Plan diagram amendment and environmental review files show Under Review.
State 2024 Table A reports 123 proposed owner units: 25 low-income deed-restricted and 98 above-moderate; no density bonus.
